pages.symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, dizziness and an abnormal heartbeat.
pages.cause: Cardiac glycosides in the plant can disrupt normal heart function.
pages.treatment: Seek emergency medical care and monitor the heart closely.

pages.symptoms: Sudden seizures, vomiting, confusion and muscle spasms.
pages.cause: Powerful neurotoxins in the plant can severely affect the nervous system.
pages.treatment: Emergency treatment is needed to control seizures and support vital functions.

pages.symptoms: Vomiting, dizziness, weakness and an abnormal or slowed heartbeat.
pages.cause: Cardiac glycosides in the plant can interfere with heart function.
pages.treatment: Seek prompt medical care with monitoring of heart function.

pages.symptoms: Dry mouth, enlarged pupils, rapid heartbeat, confusion and hallucinations.
pages.cause: Tropane alkaloids disrupt normal nervous-system function.
pages.treatment: Emergency medical treatment and supportive care are required.

pages.symptoms: Tingling, numbness, vomiting, weakness and abnormal heart rhythms.
pages.cause: Aconite alkaloids interfere with nerve and heart function.
pages.treatment: Immediate emergency care is needed to support breathing and heart function.

pages.symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, dizziness and dangerous changes in heart rhythm.
pages.cause: Cardiac glycosides in the plant can disrupt normal heart function.
pages.treatment: Seek immediate medical attention and monitor the heart.

pages.symptoms: Severe vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain and dehydration.
pages.cause: The seeds contain ricin, a toxin that prevents cells from making essential proteins.
pages.treatment: Seek immediate medical care and provide supportive treatment.

pages.symptoms: Nausea, dizziness, weakness and dangerous changes in heart rhythm.
pages.cause: Taxine compounds in the plant can interfere with the heart.
pages.treatment: Immediate emergency care and cardiac monitoring are required.
